_comment: Tickers to collect book-to-bill ratio for -- the semiconductor and aerospace/defense subset of advisor_universe.json, not the whole universe, mirroring pipeline/config/operating_kpi_universe.json's rationale. Derived once from public/data/advisor.json's screen_universe sector/industry classification (2026-08-27 snapshot) for the Yahoo industries: Semiconductor Equipment & Materials, Semiconductors, and Aerospace & Defense. A company's sector/industry classification changes rarely enough that this list does not need to be regenerated every run; regenerate by re-filtering a fresh screen_universe snapshot on the same industry set if it drifts. IMPORTANT provenance note this module's collector script uses to interpret its own coverage numbers: book-to-bill is a semiconductor-capital-equipment convention first (AMAT, ENTG, KLAC, LRCX, ONTO, TER, VECO cite either SEMI's industry-wide figure or their own company ratio about as routinely as retailers cite comps); fabless/IDM chipmakers (e.g. AMD, AVGO, MU, NVDA, QCOM, TXN) and aerospace/defense primes (e.g. BA, GD, LMT, NOC, RTX) disclose it far less consistently, if at all -- primes more often report a segment-scoped book-to-bill or simply state backlog in dollars with no ratio. A low match rate across this list, concentrated outside the semicap-equipment names, is the expected result, not evidence the extraction is broken.
